title: I made my own top down Pokémon arena fighter with online multiplayer. Up to 25 Pokémon so far, legendary summons and party modes.
author: SilverBits1001

comments.author: Double_Suggestion385
comments.body: This is cool but.. cease and desist incoming

replies.author: SilverBits1001
replies.body: lol you’re not wrong, but I mainly made it for just me and my friends to play though,  I haven’t made anything public

replies.author: SilverBits1001
replies.body: Only if the Nintendo lawyers sign off haha

replies.author: Double_Suggestion385
replies.body: Why do I feel like this is the future, custom made personal games

replies.author: SilverBits1001
replies.body: That’s actually what I was joking to my friends about. That in the future waiting for a game to download will be replaced with waiting for your AI to generate your own custom game.

replies.author: VyronDaGod
replies.body: I just promised my kid a custom game if they did well in school so...yeah

replies.author: Motor-Travel-7560
replies.body: This is why if you're making a Nintendo fangame, it's best to just finish it, shadow drop it, and THEN do the promotion. You've started the project knowing you'll make no money, so wishlists/marketing/whatever is going to be a non-issue.

comments.author: BowlingShoeThief
comments.body: Want lol,  my nephew and I would tear it up

replies.author: SilverBits1001
replies.body: lol it’s honestly about of fun!

comments.author: joeban1
comments.body: This is now about the 5th version of this type pokemon gameplay i’ve seen someone make in the past week

replies.author: SilverBits1001
replies.body: Tbh, that’s part of the reason why I built it. I kept seeing other ones and they looked fun but no way to play it. So I ended up just making one for myself

comments.author: orangekirby
comments.body: May I ask what you used to do the attacks? Seen a couple other of these types of games and the attack animations on this one looks pretty sleek

replies.author: SilverBits1001
replies.body: So the spores are all from PMD sprite repository. And then I used some free asset packs on itchio for VFX animations like explosions etc

comments.author: Friend135
comments.body: This looks awesome!  How did you manage the art and animation process?

replies.author: SilverBits1001
replies.body: The sprites and impact vfx are from open source resources. The battle maps and some of the combat effects (like legendary attack animations) are just through Claude, and then some sprites like the conveyor belts, or chemical vats as seen on the maps are through pixel lab.

comments.author: ExpressionExpert1314
comments.body: Really cool. whats your workflow for making the sprites?

replies.author: SilverBits1001
replies.body: I used pixel lab for some of it but most of it is from open source resources. I went on to a little more detail ok a different comment

comments.author: Comet7777
comments.body: Nintendo just took down the Pokemon Snap x Godleneye stuff. I wish you luck, but wouldn’t bother touching Nintendo IPs!

replies.author: SilverBits1001
replies.body: I have no plans on making it public. More so was just sharing my personal project

comments.author: FortuneApart453
comments.body:
It’s awesome man! I always see the comments on those type of copyrighted games but we can just do things for fun and not always thinking about money, make it public or whatever. Just sharing something you enjoyed doing it! 
Congrats man and have fun!

comments.body: Would be happy to get my hands on this. Oh, and fuck Nintendog.
